en: Points of Controversy The Chapter on the Decades The Tenth Division: The Decade on the Path of Certainty (Niyāma)
The Discourse on Cessation:
If the five aggregates are not ceased in one seeking rebirth, do the five aggregates arise as a result of that action?
Yes, they do.
Is there a combination of ten aggregates, such that ten aggregates come into manifestation?
One should not say so... [and so on] ...
Is there a combination of ten aggregates, such that ten aggregates come into manifestation?
“Yes,” [you say]. “Then do two contacts … pe … two consciousnesses coexist?
You should not say so … pe … When the five aggregates sought for rebirth have not yet ceased, do the four functional aggregates arise?
“Yes,” you say.
“Is there a convergence of nine aggregates, such that nine aggregates come into manifestation?
You must not say so … [and so on] …
Is there a convergence of nine aggregates, such that nine aggregates come into manifestation?
Yes. Is there a convergence of two contacts … pe … or of two consciousnesses?
It should not be said so … pe …
Is it the case that functional knowledge arises while the five aggregates conducive to rebirth have not yet ceased? Yes.
Does this mean there is a convergence of six aggregates, and that six aggregates come into manifestation?
It should not be said thus...
[as before] ...Is there a combination of six aggregates, such that six aggregates come into manifestation?
Yes. Is there a combination of two contacts... [as before] ...or of two consciousnesses? No.
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it the case that the Path arises when the five aggregates sought for rebirth have ceased? Yes.
"Does one who is dying develop the path? Does one who has passed away develop the path?
One should not say so... [as before].
The Discussion on Cessation is finished.
